rationale: For an A-phase-to-ground fault, I1=I2=I0=Vf/(Z1+Z2+Z0+3Zf). Z1=0.042+j0.31, Z2=0.045+j0.29, Z0=0.12+j0.82, Zf=0.04 pu, so the total is 0.327+j1.42 pu. Ipu=1/(0.327+j1.42)=0.686257 at -77.0319 deg. Ibase=Sbase/(sqrt(3)*Vbase)=50/(sqrt(3)*13.8)=2.091849 kA, giving each sequence current 1.435561 kA. Fault/residual current 3*I0=4.306683 kA.
